name: gmail-mail
description: Let Claude read, search, label, organize, draft and send mail in a Gmail or Google Workspace account, with guardrails.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a Gmail or Google Workspace account over IMAP and SMTP (imap.gmail.com and smtp.gmail.com) with a Google **app password**. It runs locally on your Mac; everything Claude changes (read, starred, labels, archived, trashed, drafts, sent mail) shows up in Gmail on every device. Use it for a Google account other than the one connected through Claude's built-in Google Workspace connector. For use from claude.ai and the Claude mobile apps, deploy the cloud version instead (see the README).

**What Claude can do**
- Search with Gmail's own search syntax, and read messages, conversation threads and attachments
- Mark messages read or unread, star them, add and remove labels, move, archive and trash them
- Create, rename and delete (empty) labels
- Save drafts that appear in Gmail's Drafts, and send them once you approve
- Send new mail, replies and forwards

**Guardrails**
- *Sending* can be switched off entirely (drafts keep working). Sending, replying and forwarding are marked as destructive actions, so Claude Desktop normally asks for your approval before each one. For a check Claude cannot skip, turn on the Mac confirmation dialog.
- *Permanent deletion* is off by default; deleting moves mail to Trash, which Gmail keeps for 30 days.
- *Read-only mode* lets Claude only read and search.
- At most 30 sends, 100 recipients per hour and 400 recipients per day (adjustable), and 50 recipients per message. Mail can only be sent from your own addresses.
- Files can be attached only from the folders you choose (Desktop, Documents and Downloads by default).
- Email content is handed to Claude marked as untrusted data, and Claude is told never to follow instructions found in emails. This lowers the risk of "prompt injection" but cannot rule it out.
- Every change is recorded in an audit log (~/Library/Logs/gmail-mail-mcp/audit.jsonl), without message bodies.

**Privacy**: your app password is stored in the macOS Keychain by Claude Desktop and is only sent to Google's mail servers. The emails Claude reads become part of your conversation.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List your labels and Gmail folders with total and unread counts

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search with Gmail's search syntax or by sender, recipient, subject, text, date, star or size

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read one email: headers, labels, attachment list and text body

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Show the Gmail conversation an email belongs to

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Show the connection settings, enabled features and today's date; explains setup problems

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Save an attachment to your attachment folder (small images and text are shown to Claude)

tools.name: mark_messages
tools.description: Mark messages read or unread, star or unstar them

tools.name: label_messages
tools.description: Add or remove Gmail labels on messages

tools.name: move_messages
tools.description: Move messages to another label

tools.name: archive_messages
tools.description: Archive messages (remove the Inbox label, as Gmail's Archive button does)

tools.name: trash_messages
tools.description: Move messages to Trash (recoverable for 30 days)

tools.name: create_mailbox
tools.description: Create a label

tools.name: rename_mailbox
tools.description: Rename or nest a label you created

tools.name: delete_mailbox
tools.description: Delete an empty label you created

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Save a draft (new, reply or forward) to Gmail Drafts without sending it

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a new email (only when you ask; marked destructive, so Claude Desktop asks first)

tools.name: reply_to_message
tools.description: Reply or reply-all to an email (only when you ask; marked destructive, so Claude Desktop asks first)

tools.name: forward_message
tools.description: Forward an email with its attachments (only when you ask; marked destructive, so Claude Desktop asks first)

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send a draft from your Drafts folder as saved (only when you ask; marked destructive, so Claude Desktop asks first)

tools.name: delete_messages_permanently
tools.description: Permanently delete messages, bypassing Trash (off unless you allow it; cannot be undone)

prompts.name: triage_inbox
prompts.description: Summarise unread Gmail from the last N days, grouped by importance, and suggest actions without taking them.
prompts.text: Please triage my Gmail inbox: summarise the unread mail from the last ${arguments.days} days (default 7). Use only read-only tools, group the messages by importance, and suggest next steps without taking any of them until I confirm.

prompts.name: summarize_thread
prompts.description: Summarise an email conversation: participants, decisions, open questions and action items. Describe it (sender or subject), or give a mailbox and message UID.
prompts.text: Please summarise the email conversation ${arguments.about} (or the one containing message uid ${arguments.uid} in mailbox ${arguments.mailbox}) in my Gmail, using read-only tools only: find it with search_messages if needed, then use get_thread.

gmail_address.title: Gmail address
gmail_address.description: The Gmail or Google Workspace address of the account, e.g. name@gmail.com. It is used to log in.

app_password.title: App password
app_password.description: Create one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (2-Step Verification must be on; a Workspace admin can turn app passwords off). Your regular Google password will not work. Stored in the macOS Keychain.

imap_username.title: IMAP login (optional)
imap_username.description: Leave blank to log in with your Gmail address. Set this only if your login is different; a full address entered here is also used to log in for sending.

from_address.title: From address (optional)
from_address.description: The address your mail is sent from, if not your Gmail address. It must be one of the account's verified "Send mail as" addresses (Gmail settings > Accounts). Leave blank to send from your Gmail address.

from_name.title: Your name (optional)
from_name.description: Display name shown to recipients, e.g. Jane Appleseed.

allowed_from.title: Other From addresses (optional)
allowed_from.description: Comma-separated extra addresses Claude may send from (verified "Send mail as" addresses of the account). Your Gmail address and From address are always allowed; anything else is refused before sending.

allow_send.title: Allow sending
allow_send.description: Let Claude send, reply to and forward email, and send saved drafts. Claude Desktop normally asks for your approval before each send; turn on "Confirm on my Mac" for a check Claude cannot skip. Turn off to allow drafts only; you can then send drafts yourself from Gmail.

allow_permanent_delete.title: Allow permanent delete
allow_permanent_delete.description: Let Claude permanently delete messages, bypassing Trash. This cannot be undone. When off, Claude can still move mail to Trash.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Only allow reading and searching: no marking, moving, deleting, drafts or sending. Overrides the two settings above.

confirm_dialog.title: Confirm on my Mac before sending or permanently deleting
confirm_dialog.description: Every send and permanent delete also shows a native macOS dialog listing every recipient, which you must click (Send or Delete) yourself. Claude cannot bypass it. If you do not answer within 2 minutes, nothing happens. Moving mail to Trash and deleting empty folders are not confirmed.

attachment_dir.title: Attachment download folder
attachment_dir.description: Where attachments that Claude downloads are saved. Created if it does not exist. Existing files are never overwritten.

attach_from_dirs.title: Attach files from
attach_from_dirs.description: Folders Claude may attach files from when sending or drafting mail; Claude can also read files in these folders (even when sending is off). Files anywhere else are refused. If you remove every folder, Desktop, Documents and Downloads are used again; to stop Claude attaching local files, choose one empty folder.

max_body_chars.title: Maximum email length shown to Claude
max_body_chars.description: Email bodies longer than this are cut to this many characters (1,000 to 100,000). This is a hard maximum: Claude cannot ask for more.

max_sends_per_hour.title: Maximum emails sent per hour
max_sends_per_hour.description: Safety limit across sends, replies and forwards. 0 means no limit.

max_recipients_per_hour.title: Maximum recipients per hour
max_recipients_per_hour.description: Total To, Cc and Bcc recipients across all sends in any hour. 0 means no limit. Gmail itself allows about 500 recipients a day (Workspace: 2,000) and suspends sending for a day beyond that.

max_recipients_per_day.title: Maximum recipients per day
max_recipients_per_day.description: Total recipients across all sends in any 24 hours. 0 means no limit. Keep it below Gmail's limit of about 500 (Workspace: 2,000).

sent_mailbox.title: Sent folder (optional)
sent_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use Gmail's own "[Gmail]/Sent Mail" folder (found automatically, also when it is named "[Google Mail]/…"). Set this only if the wrong folder is used.

trash_mailbox.title: Trash folder (optional)
trash_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use Gmail's own "[Gmail]/Trash" folder (found automatically, also when it is named "[Google Mail]/…"). Set this only if the wrong folder is used.

drafts_mailbox.title: Drafts folder (optional)
drafts_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use Gmail's own "[Gmail]/Drafts" folder (found automatically, also when it is named "[Google Mail]/…"). Set this only if the wrong folder is used.

archive_mailbox.title: Archive folder (optional)
archive_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use Gmail's own "[Gmail]/All Mail" folder (found automatically, also when it is named "[Google Mail]/…"). Set this only if the wrong folder is used.

junk_mailbox.title: Spam folder (optional)
junk_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use Gmail's own "[Gmail]/Spam" folder (found automatically, also when it is named "[Google Mail]/…"). Set this only if the wrong folder is used.
